verdict.rationale: Omnara is general agent infrastructure. It lets you attach images and documents to a conversation (omnara-docs-9), run agents on a connected machine such as a laptop or server (omnara-docs-12), and follow, correct and approve their work from a dashboard (omnara-docs-7, omnara-docs-8, omnara-gh-3), so a PM could in principle hand an agent a mockup and steer it. However, nothing documents a design-to-implementation workflow, and setup (YAML configs, model providers, machine connection) looks engineer-oriented (omnara-docs-1, omnara-docs-23). Missing for 10: any documented mockup/design-to-code capability, evidence that a non-engineer can produce a working implementation end to end, a no-engineering-setup path, and hands-on corroboration of PM use.
